name: Using Qiskit (v1.x API), implement a quantum circuit that prepares the Bell stat
task_prompt: Using Qiskit (v1.x API), implement a quantum circuit that prepares the Bell state |Φ⁺⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2. Then, using the Statevector simulator, compute the statevector and verify that the probabilities of measuring |00⟩ and |11⟩ are each 0.5. Additionally, compute the operator matrix of the circuit and confirm that it is unitary (i.e., U†U = I). Provide the complete Python code and the verification steps.
